figures.caption: The first complete frame displays the original signed array.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at the initial sort ready return boundary. The array is two, minus two, three, minus four, zero, one, minus three, minus one. The algorithm selector, phase and exchange count are zero. The eight white bar heights are seven, three, eight, one, five, six, two and four.

figures.caption: The first insertion exchange is complete and its new frame is published.
figures.alt: Four annotated details after the first adjacent insertion exchange. The signed array is minus two, two, three, minus four, zero, one, minus three, minus one. Selector zero chooses insertion. Phase and exchange count are one. Only columns zero and one change from the original frame, to heights three and seven.

figures.caption: Selection sort exchanges the suffix minimum with the first position.
figures.alt: Four annotated details after the first selection exchange. The signed array is minus four, minus two, three, two, zero, one, minus three, minus one. The algorithm selector is one, phase is one and exchange count is one. Columns zero and three now have heights one and seven. Instruction text is identical to the insertion fixture.

figures.caption: Insertion sort publishes its ascending array after seventeen exchanges.
figures.alt: Four annotated details at insertion completion before the renderer returns. Values are minus four, minus three, minus two, minus one, zero, one, two, three. Selector is zero, phase is two and the exchange count is decimal seventeen, stored as hexadecimal eleven. White bar heights rise from one through eight.
